name: gather
works_with: Coding agents that support skills, Claude Code plugin
short: Collects design references from your own saves, boards and pattern sites onto one linked board before you start a design.
what: Before a design is built, gather turns your brief into short searches and runs them across every connected source at once, such as Pond, marked.dev, Are.na, Cosmos, Pinterest and Mobbin. A bundled collector downloads the images and fills one local board as results land. Each reference gets a note on the part to take and a link back to its source.
who: Designers and front-end developers who want inspiration for one screen or part, gathered in one place. It does the most when you've connected your own libraries and boards.
needs: A coding agent that supports skills
Node, to run the bundled collector
Accounts on the reference sources you want to search

steps.title: Install the collection
steps.text: This adds all the skills in the repo, gather included.

steps.title: Or as a Claude Code plugin
steps.text: Plugin skills take a prefix, such as `/userinterface:audit`.

steps.title: Ask for inspiration
steps.text: gather applies on its own when you ask for references or inspo. Name the screen, the platform and what you want to look at. It asks once about sources you haven't connected.

steps.title: Review the board
steps.text: The collector serves the board locally and fills it live. Copy your picks back to the agent as the brief for the next step.

try.label: From the README
try.text: Ask for references for a desktop settings page, looking for grouping and density. With no number given, it gathers at least 20 from three sources or more.

watch: It downloads every image and video into a `.gather/` folder, which stays out of version control.
When Mobbin warns that monthly usage is high, it stops searching Mobbin.
When a source needs a login or a CAPTCHA, it stops and asks you.
